descriptions.notStarted: In order to become a Gunslinger, I must see Kyrin.
descriptions.inProgress: Kyrin says that she wants to test how far I have gotten on my training before she will help me job advance into a Gunslinger. I must first hunt down the #rOctopirates#k and collect #b15 power wind crystals#k . I must remember to use the #rDouble Shot#k skill in order to defeat the Octopirates.
descriptions.completed: I've passed Kyrin's test! I can now become a Gunslinger!
